data.title: Covering AI is a journalistic imperative, and a fast moving target : Consider This from NPR
data.description: Brett Neely, one of NPR’s editors who oversees coverage of artificial intelligence, talks about how the topic is now part of every reporter's beat - and how the pace of transformation impacts coverage choices.This episode was produced by Gabriel Sanchez, with engineering by Damian Herring. Our director is Vincent Acovino. It was edited by Adam Raney.  Our executive producer is Courtney Dorning.Support public media with NPR+ and enjoy perks for over 25 podcasts like this one. This show’s perks include bonus episodes and sponsor-free listening. Learn more at plus.npr.org.
